newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia to sell 51 pct of Sibneft oil firm May 12.
newsitem.headline: Russia to sell 51 pct of Sibneft oil firm May 12.

text.p: Russia will sell 51 percent of shares in NK Sibneft oil company at an investment tender on May 12, the Russian Federal Property Fund said on Tuesday.
It gave no other details of the tender.
The shares represent a package of shares managed by ZAO Neftyanaya Finansovaya Kompaniya, founded by United Bank and Russian oil trader ZAO FORNEFT under a government's shares-for-loans scheme.
Sibneft's main production unit is AO Noyabrskneftegaz.
Sibneft produced 18.61 million tonnes of oil in 1996, down from 20.34 million tonnes in 1995.
Vertically-integrated Sibirskaya Neftyanaya Kompaniya is one of Russia's mini-majors. Its authorised capital is 7.23 billion roubles.
